q: What does the free audit cover?
a: The audit is a 30 minute walkthrough of how your business runs from start to finish. We look at five areas: how customers find you, how fast they hear back when they reach out, how you follow up and book them, how the work gets delivered, and how you bring past customers back. For every step, we note who does it, what tool they use, and whether it runs on its own, depends on someone remembering, or is where customers slip away. You leave with a clear map of your business, a list of the leaks we found, and an estimate of what each one costs you every month, whether or not you work with us.

q: What kinds of tasks can your AI systems handle?
a: Anything repetitive that costs you time or customers. That includes answering calls, calling back new leads, booking appointments, sending reminders, following up on quotes, asking for reviews, and reaching out to past customers who went quiet.

q: How long does it take to get my AI system live?
a: Most systems are live within about 7 days of our kickoff call. Simple setups like an AI receptionist can go live faster, while custom builds with several connected systems take a little longer. We give you a clear timeline right after your free audit.

q: Will AI automation disrupt my current operations?
a: No. Your AI systems fill the gaps your team can't cover, like after hours calls, overflow, and follow ups. We build around the tools you already use, test everything before launch, and handle the whole setup for you.

q: How much does AI automation cost?
a: It depends on what your audit finds and which leaks you want to fix first. After your free audit, we give you a clear quote and show you what each system should pay back, so you can see the return before you decide.
